Assistant ProfessorB.Com (Procedure & Practices of Taxation), M.Com (Finance, Bangalore University) Linkedin Link Shakeela M. K. is an Assistant Professor at SSMRV College, with 11 years of teaching experience. Specialising in finance, accounting and taxation, she has co-authored two textbooks and published a few research papers. Formerly a faculty member at NMKRV College for Women, she also has expertise in fashion designing, holding a qualification from IIFT. Specialisations and Interests Finance, Accounting, Taxation, HR and Management Publications and Career Highlights “Navigating Green Maze: Consumer Perception and Strategic Insights in Green Marketing”, Proceedings of National Conference “Innovate to Elevate: Fostering Creativity for Sustainable Business”, August 2024, Dayananda Sagar College for Arts, Science and Commerce.
